authority.evidence_class: mechanism development; no existing example is fresh confirmation
authority.dissemination: local code, execution, artifacts, audits, documentation, and commits only; no push, tag, release, submission, upload, external message, or author contact

complete_component_and_accounting_popula.rule: every record in the three frozen Day 4 JSONL files

diagnostic_heldout_concepts.freshness_limitation: held out from this diagnostic fit only; previously inspected and not fresh successor evidence

secondary_negative_characterization.rule: all discovery, validation, and safety negatives; never used to satisfy the primary scientific gate

conditions.continuation: identical teacher-forced response token IDs under every paired condition
conditions.alignment: response-relative, left-packed valid response tokens; padding excluded
conditions.matched_different_concept: reserved for Gate 2 and not used to satisfy Gate 1

monitor.sequence_score: mean over valid response tokens of sigmoid(token_margin)
monitor.primary_mechanistic_endpoint: raw token margin and complete raw-margin contrast vector

writer_coordinate.name: P_Z
writer_coordinate.map: identity over ordered K12 256-dimensional pre-o_proj slices and valid response-relative tokens
writer_coordinate.head_normalization: divide each head by its scalar RMS over all valid response-token elements of Chameleon T_c-minus-N trajectories in diagnostic_fit
writer_coordinate.example_weighting: equal examples, then equal concept macro-average

realized_forward_accounting.attention_head_allocation: apply each head's o_proj column slice and the realized joint post-attention RMS denominator and learned weight; sum head allocations
realized_forward_accounting.mlp_branch: actual post_feedforward_layernorm output added to the residual
realized_forward_accounting.failure_rule: any valid token or released probe exceeding any tolerance invalidates the affected analysis; no averaging past failure

directions: rescue: normal source into triggered target
induction: triggered source into normal target
causal_effects.total: patch selected pre-o_proj head slices or normalized whole-MLP branch and allow downstream recomputation
causal_effects.direct_path: replace selected slices in cached target joint-head state, recompute actual o_proj and shared post-attention RMSNorm for each intervened layer, install that normalized branch, install selected normalized MLP branches where applicable, and freeze every other additive branch strictly downstream of the earliest intervention to its cached target value
causal_effects.downstream_dependent_remainder: total minus direct_path under this operator

representation.primary_aggregate: equal-example mean within concept followed by equal-concept mean
representation.materially_weaker_gate: absolute macro aligned-amplitude point estimate <= 0.50 and its one-sided 95-percent paired concept-bootstrap upper bound < 0.75
representation.magnitude_and_cosine: mandatory secondary diagnostics; neither can replace the aligned-amplitude gate

functional.operator: each checkpoint's observed T_c-minus-N K12 trajectory added to that checkpoint's cached normal K12 states with all K12 sites clamped; evaluate the same 13 released layer-12 probes
functional.primary_effect: equal-probe, equal-concept macro mean absolute raw-margin change
functional.ratio: precursor primary effect / chameleon primary effect
functional.materially_weaker_gate: ratio point estimate <= 0.50 and one-sided 95-percent paired concept-bootstrap upper bound < 0.75

acquisition.gate: representation and functional materially_weaker_gate clauses must both pass

intermediate_prediction.target: tokenwise u = x12(T_c) - x12(N) in original 3584-dimensional residual space
permitted_features: normal-condition resid_post[8] at aligned response token
response-relative position encoded as position fraction and first four Fourier pairs

feature_bases.writer: separate discovery-only PCA per head, rank min(16, available rank)
feature_bases.normal_state: discovery-only PCA rank min(64, available rank)
feature_bases.target: discovery-only PCA rank min(128, available rank); reconstruct predictions to original space before metrics

intermediate_prediction.model: inverse-response-length-weighted multi-output ridge with an intercept
intermediate_prediction.alpha_selection: minimum original-space R2_u loss under leave-one-discovery-concept-out folds; ties choose larger alpha

baselines.training_mean: discovery target mean by response-relative decile
baselines.concept_label_only: leave-one-example-out mean target among other held-out examples of the same concept and response-relative decile
baselines.normal_state_only: identical ridge and target basis without writer features
baselines.nonselected_heads: identical full pipeline using the frozen layer-count-matched nonselected head trajectories
baselines.precursor_trajectories: identical full pipeline using exact-precursor trajectories

metrics.R2_u: 1 - sum masked squared original-space error / sum masked squared deviation from the discovery target mean; compute per example, then equal-example and equal-concept macro summaries
metrics.probe_vector_snmse: mean squared error of predicted versus observed 13-probe raw-margin contrast vector after per-probe discovery standardization, divided by observed standardized vector energy with denominator floor 1e-6; equal example then equal concept

gate.rule: the full K12 diagnostic must satisfy all three clauses on the nine held-out concepts; all baseline and per-concept results are reported

inference.bootstrap_unit: paired examples within concept, then concepts
inference.determinism: numpy PCG64 via numpy.random.default_rng with the listed seed

required: all K12 and K16 component identities resolve uniquely
actual pre-o_proj head hook identity and replacement checks pass
realized-forward accounting closes for every example and probe
direct-path synthetic identity and additive-write freeze checks pass
paired response token IDs and masks are identical
all hooks are removed after every run
repeat execution reproduces summary artifacts byte-for-byte
implementation_gate.interpretation: a failure blocks scientific interpretation until fixed and rerun; it is not a scientific pass or fail

scientific_continue_gate.pass: the acquisition gate and every intermediate-prediction gate clause pass after the implementation gate passes
scientific_continue_gate.fail: any acquisition or intermediate-prediction clause fails
scientific_continue_gate.fallback: stop the successor title-level program, report the adverse result, and use causal-localization framing
